01 / THE IDEA

The game updates.
Your collection should come along.

You’ve made Geometry Dash your own. The tools, tweaks, and little improvements are part of how you play. A game update shouldn’t mean starting that collection from scratch.

Geode 2.209 is an independent project with that ambition: launch on 2.209 and 2.2091, and work toward compatibility with mods made for 2.208 and the broader 2.2 era.

The ambition is to support all mods from 2.208 and 2.2. That isn’t a tested guarantee yet.

04 / GOOD TO KNOW

A little clarity.

Before you make the jump.

Is this the official Geode project?+
Geode 2.209 is an independent project based on Geode. It is not an official Geode release and is not affiliated with RobTop Games. The original Geode team’s website is geode-sdk.org.
Will all my older mods work?+
Supporting all mods made for 2.208 and the 2.2 era is the project’s goal. Universal compatibility has not been verified. A mod may depend on a specific game version, Geode API, binary layout, or platform, so individual testing and sometimes changes to the mod may be necessary.
Where can I download Geode 2.209?+
Check the project’s GitHub releases. This site does not certify a build as compatible; use the specific release notes to check its supported game versions and platforms. Upstream releases inherited by a fork are not proof of 2.209 support.
How can I help test compatibility?+
Start with the repository and its current instructions. When reporting a problem, include your platform, exact game and loader versions, mod name and version, reproduction steps, and relevant logs. You can check existing reports or open one in the project issue tracker.
Where are the original Geode instructions?+
Visit the official Geode installation page for upstream instructions, or the Geode documentation for development resources. Upstream support can differ from the goals of this project.
